Use Tier 2, focusing on model_design and training_evaluation: add one jointly trained causal convolutional residual block before the existing GRU. The current model reaches macro validation HR@10 of 0.5737, while sampled softmax regressed and prefix-pooling and attention extensions failed implementation, so this experiment retains the successful objective and tests a different representation. The hypothesis is that explicitly encoding short item-order patterns will help the recurrent model distinguish local purchase contexts, particularly in Electronics; the available results do not establish this as the cause of the plateau.

In GRURec.encode, apply a width-three Conv1d to the normalized item embeddings, using exactly two positions of left padding and no right padding, followed by GELU and a linear projection back to dim. Add this projected feature to the normalized embeddings before the existing input dropout and two-layer GRU, masking padded positions before convolution and after residual addition. Initialize the final convolutional projection to zero so the initial network reproduces the existing representation, then learn the entire network jointly through the unchanged positive/negative softplus objective. Preserve tied candidate embeddings, learned item bias and scale, eight uniform negatives, history sampling, optimizer, and training settings to isolate this architectural change.

Update checkpoint architecture metadata and write_predict_script together so inference strictly reconstructs the augmented GRURec and loads exactly one newly trained checkpoint per category. Before sustained training, check output shapes, finite gradients, causal invariance, initial residual equivalence, and checkpoint-reload prediction parity without additional training runs. Preserve all four routes, supplied splits, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, and single-GPU execution within the remaining shared budget. Select one checkpoint per category using fixed validation HR@10 with the existing NDCG tie-break, retain identical validation and prediction preprocessing, print the actual final validation score, and judge improvement against 0.5737 using the pinned host evaluation with 200 users and 99 unique negatives per category.
